cap_base.description: SA 1u keycap bottom width/depth, KeyV2 sa.scad ($bottom_key_width)

sa_taper.description: SA base-to-top width difference, KeyV2 sa.scad ($width_difference)

sa_top.description: SA top surface depth (front to back)

dish_depth.description: SA spherical dish depth, KeyV2 sa.scad ($dish_depth)

dish_r.description: Spherical dish radius: dish_depth deep at the centre, its rim dish_overdraw past the top edges

dish_off.description: Dish sphere centre distance above the top surface

wall.description: Keycap wall and roof thickness (SLA functional wall)

corner_r.description: Keycap vertical corner radius, KeyV2 sa.scad ($corner_radius)

stem_inset.description: Stem bottom raised above the skirt bottom, KeyV2 default

cross_arm.description: Cherry MX stem cross arm length (Cherry MX datasheet 4.0 mm)

cross_thk.description: Cherry MX stem cross arm thickness (Cherry MX datasheet 1.17 mm)

stem_clear.description: Per-side clearance in the cross socket for an SLA press fit on the switch stem

cross_depth.description: Cross socket depth (MX stem cross is ~3.6 mm tall)

sa_r1_h.description: SA row 1 height at top centre, KeyV2 sa.scad

sa_r1_tilt.description: SA row 1 top tilt toward the typist, KeyV2 sa.scad

sa_r2_tilt.description: SA row 2 top tilt toward the typist

sa_r4_tilt.description: SA row 4 top tilt (away from the typist)

sa_r3_zi.description: Row 3 inner roof height at the centre

sa_r3_wi.description: Row 3 inner roof: how much narrower than the base it is

sa_r1_zi.description: Row 1 inner roof height at the centre

sa_r1_wi.description: Row 1 inner roof: how much narrower than the base it is

stab_2u.description: Cherry stabilizer stem offset from centre for 2u–2.75u keys (23.876 mm wire spacing)

stab_625.description: Cherry stabilizer stem offset for a 6.25u spacebar (100 mm spacing)

sa_r2_zi.description: Row 2 inner roof height at the centre

sa_r2_wi.description: Row 2 inner roof: how much narrower than the base it is

sa_r4_zi.description: Row 4 inner roof height at the centre

sa_r4_wi.description: Row 4 inner roof: how much narrower than the base it is

side_bulge.description: Outward bulge of the cap sides at mid-height (0 = straight SA sides)

top_edge_r.description: Subtle fillet on the keycap top rim (where the dish, or the spacebar crown, meets the sides), so the edge isn't sharp

dish_overdraw.description: How far the spherical dish's rim runs past the top front/back edges (dish footprint = top width + 2 × this); 3 mm also clears the top corners, so every top edge dips

space_crown.description: Spacebar convex top: how far the top front/back edges sit below the crown at the centre

space_crown_r.description: Spacebar convex top radius (cylinder along the key's length)

space_crown_zc.description: Spacebar crown cylinder axis height; crown 0.05 mm under the loft top so it cuts cleanly instead of touching tangentially

legend_size.description: Legend capital height on the keycap tops

legend_depth.description: Engraved legend depth below the dish bottom (leaves wall - legend_depth of roof under the letters)

legend_mod_size.description: Capital height of word legends (RETURN, SHIFT, F1, PGDN...), small like the C64's modifier keys

legend_pair_size.description: Capital height of stacked two-symbol legends (shifted symbol over the base one)

features.name: Trim stems to the convex top

requirements.description: Print each keycap with the open bottom toward the platform, tilted ~30-45°, supports only on the skirt rim and inside the cavity; tops (dish or spacebar crown) and outer sides stay free of support marks, so the cup opening faces the platform (no suction cup).
